lines.zh: 我在河滩上走，身上还在滴水。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank still dripping.

lines.zh: 三格半高的身子，走起来很慢。
lines.en: Three and a half blocks tall, and slow.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥陷到我的脚踝。
lines.en: The marsh mud sinks to my ankle.
MarineDevimon's tendrils drag water.
I know this river mouth.

lines.zh: 潮水一退，我就往沙地上走。
lines.en: The tide pulls back and I walk onto the sand.
My tail drags on the ground.

lines.zh: 水草挂在我的角和爪上。
lines.en: Kelp hangs on my horns and claws.
I step into the shallows.
The mud water clouds at my passing.
The beach lies beyond.
Water drips from my horns.

lines.zh: 我站在水里，只露出一半。
lines.en: I stand in the water, half showing.
Water falls from my shoulders.
This body is heavy.
I lift a hand and let it fall.
The reeds here bend under me.

lines.zh: 这里安静得像死了一样。
lines.en: It is quiet as death here.

lines.zh: 我低头，泥水里映出这副脸。
lines.en: I look down; the muddy water shows this face of mine.

lines.zh: 水里有一个模模糊糊的我。
lines.en: A blurred me looks back.
I do not much like it.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，泥拉成一条线。
lines.en: I lift a foot and the mud strings out.
Then it comes down again.
A white bird is on the river.
It dares not settle near me.

lines.zh: 我把爪子在泥里转了转。
lines.en: I turn my claw in the mud.
You stand on the riverbank.

lines.zh: 你站在河滩上，靴子湿透了。
lines.en: You stand on the riverbank, boots soaked through.
I stand two bodies above you.
You look up at me.

lines.zh: 这张脸不会笑，你别指望。
lines.en: This face does not smile; do not hope for it.
That does not mean I do not care.
You carry no weapon.
That is stranger still.
What are you doing here.

lines.zh: 这条河不是给人散步的。
lines.en: This river is not for strolling.
You pulled your coat tighter.

lines.zh: 雾里你的呼吸，我听得清楚。
lines.en: In the fog I hear every breath you take.
What I breathe out is black.
The rocks are behind you.
The water is before you.
I am between them.
Ink runs off me.
I retreat into the water.
My ink spills into the water.
I wipe my shoulder once.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，臂上的肉在抖。
lines.en: I crouch lower, the flesh of my arm trembling.
I retreat into deeper water.
My ink spreads through the water.
I press my ribs.

lines.zh: 被打中后，我的呼吸乱了。
lines.en: After the blow my breathing comes ragged.
I drive my claws into the mud.
That little bit of seafood.
The smell fades quickly.
I hunt the river mouth for food.
Put it in the water, then.
I will take it in the water.
That little thing in your palm.

lines.zh: 这么点吃的，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: That much would not fill the gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 把东西放石头上，我过来拿。
lines.en: Leave it on the stone; I will come take it.
The stone is midstream.
I will simply walk over.
That in your hand is a little fishy.
Fishy is not bad.
You bumped my leg, steady yourself.
You crash into me and I barely lift a foot.
Your prints stay in the mud.
The pits I leave are larger.
Your legs sink into the mud.
My hand is there to hold.
I do not intend to offer it.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，湿翅膀擦过你肩。
lines.en: I turn aside; my wet wing brushes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你的手扶了一下我的腿。
lines.en: Your hand touched my leg.
You cannot get around this leg.
This body is not suited to it.
And the tide at the river mouth will not wait.
The river mouth rises and falls each day.
I have no time for that.
Things in the water do not do this.
You and I are not the same kind.
I only keep this river.
Other matters are none of mine.
I have been in the water too long.
Why do you ask this.
There seems to be something in the mud.
I pinch it up to look.
It is a stone.
I toss it back into the river.
I reach two fingers down.
And bring up a pinch of mud.
It slipped into the weeds.
I did not go after it.
It is hard to see in the water.
There is a water insect on it.
You have backed into the mud.
Every step sinks here.
I have no cause to chase.
I only have to walk over.

lines.zh: 你脚在水里，我在你脚边。
lines.en: Your feet are in the water, and I am at your feet.
This works in my favor.
I do not intend to reason.

lines.zh: 我的爪在水下已经张开了。
lines.en: My claws are already open underwater.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀泡在水里，还张着。
lines.en: My wings stay spread even underwater.

lines.zh: 你还有一点时间，Doctase 已经缠上。
lines.en: You have a little time; Doctase has coiled.
Then put it to use.

lines.zh: 我往前挪半步，水花溅到你。
lines.en: I shift half a step and water splashes you.

lines.zh: 河口的泥里，我这长身子一拧就到。
lines.en: One twist of this long body crosses the estuary mud.
The mud swallows my feet.

lines.zh: 我一步不停，泥水跟着我。
lines.en: I do not stop; mud and water trail me.

lines.zh: 你退到河滩上，前面没路了。
lines.en: You fall back to the shoal; there is no way ahead.

lines.zh: 我从水里伸手，把你往下拖。
lines.en: I reach from the water and drag you down.
The water will push you toward me.
I am half a step behind you.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候我退一步。
lines.en: When you turn, I step back.
Raised by the sea, and the ink sac is mine.
I know this boundary.
Step across and I move.
I stir the water with my tail.
I bring a claw down.
That is Doctase.
A sheet of muddy water sprays up.
You retreat a long way.

lines.zh: 我的爪从水上劈到水下。
lines.en: My claw cuts from above the water to below.
You are thrown down into the mud.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩把你按下去。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder and push you down.
There is no purchase in the mud.

lines.zh: 我从水下伸手抓住你的脚踝。
lines.en: I reach up from the water and take your ankle.
I push you under the water.
I fling you onto the bank.
My claw marks stay in the mud.
The water at the river mouth turns black.
I rise out of it.
The ink stains the water.
A layer of black rises on the water.

lines.zh: 那摊黑水，是我爬上来的痕迹。
lines.en: That black water is the trail I left climbing out.
Every bird on the bank takes flight.
I walk out of the ink.

lines.zh: 我从河口爬上来，身上滴着水。
lines.en: I crawl out of the river mouth, still dripping.
There is no one on the beach.
Only I am at the river mouth.
There is a fresh layer of mud on the bank.
That is where I walked.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的甲，我拍了一下。
lines.en: Fire scorches my armor and I slap at it.

lines.zh: 我摔进泥里，半边陷下去。
lines.en: I fall in the mud and half of me sinks.

lines.zh: 水是我的地方，不会淹我。
lines.en: The water is my place; it cannot drown me.

lines.zh: 爆风把泥浆掀起来一片。
lines.en: The blast throws up a sheet of mud.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的肩，我身上还在滴水。
lines.en: A spike struck my shoulder, and I still drip.

lines.zh: 那法术压住了我的动作。
lines.en: That spell pins my movements.

lines.zh: 饿了以后我连爪子都抬不起。
lines.en: Hungry, I cannot even lift a claw.

lines.zh: 雷落在水面上，一路烧到我。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and runs to me.
Everything under my feet is gone.
